Subject: OptiMed - Production Access & Security Gate Checklist

Hi Natalie & OptiMed infra team,

Thanks again for the kickoff earlier — following up with the specific items our implementation team needs to enable Redwood in your production environment. Below is a short security/access checklist and a suggested sequencing for cutover scheduling. Please confirm which items you can provide this week and when you prefer a 2-hour cutover window.

Required for SSO/Provisioning:
- SAML metadata (xml) for OptiMed IdP (entityID, x509 cert) — we can import or you can upload.
- SCIM: service account (scim) with a minimum of write:user and write:group. Provide the provisioning endpoint and a sample user and group attribute set (we recommend mapping managerEmail and officeLocation).
- SCIM filter: do you want group-only provisioning (recommended for role groups)?

Network & service accounts:
- IP allowlist: provide CIDR ranges for production egress (we'll add them to our ingress allowlists). Preferred format: CSV of start_ip,end_ip,description.
- Service account naming convention + TTL: we recommend a dedicated long-lived service account for provisioning and a short-lived runtime SA for any integrations. Default token TTL we recommend is 90 days; please flag if your policy requires shorter rotation.

Org & policy controls:
- Admin role scoping: confirm which internal roles should be allowed (admin/read-only/delegate).
- Audit/log retention expectations (we keep request logs; provide retention window if you need special handling).

Attachments: attaching a draft mutual-action-plan (mutual-action-plan.xlsx) with milestones and owners.

Proposed cutover window (prelim): 2026-05-28 02:00–04:00 UTC (low traffic). If that doesn't work, propose two alternatives.

Next steps: please reply with the SAML metadata and IP ranges (or a contact for your network ops). If you'd like, we can loop in Ben (onboarding) for a short runbook walkthrough.

Thanks,

--

1) SCIM attribute set: we plan to provision users from our HRMS (WorkforcePro). Does Redwood support mapping managerEmail? Our org relies on manager chains for approvals.

2) Group-only provisioning: we prefer provisioning by groups for role-based access. Is that supported natively or do we need to maintain a separate attribute?

Hi Natalie / Carlos — thanks for the quick follow-up. Answers below and I've attached the SAML metadata template and a sample network CSV for the allowlist.

1) managerEmail: yes — Redwood's SCIM connector supports mapping managerEmail and we can use that field to populate manager/approval chains. We'll send a mapping template (JSON) separately so you can confirm attribute names.

2) Group-only provisioning: supported. We can enable group scoping on the SCIM connector so only users in provisioned groups are created/updated. This is our recommended flow for role-based access.

3) IP allowlist: we require explicit CIDRs to apply to our edge config. If your provider exposes a stable named range ID (not a CIDR), we can accept a published list during onboarding but will need updates each time the underlying CIDRs change. To reduce churn, consider committing to a quarterly scheduled sync and providing the CSV before each maintenance window.

Service account & token policy:
- We recommend a dedicated SCIM service account with 90-day token TTL for provisioning. If your policy mandates 30 days, we can support that but will need automated rotation.
- For runtime integrations (webhooks, connectors) recommend short-lived tokens + dedicated service accounts.

Security recommendations (high level):
- Rotate SAML cert at onboarding and add cert expiry reminders to your calendar.
- Limit admin role assignments and use delegated operators for day-to-day tasks.
- Confirm audit-retention: default 180 days unless you request extended retention.

Attachments included: optimed-saml-metadata.xml (template), network-allowlist.csv (example). Also updated the mutual-action-plan with owners against each milestone.

Proposed next steps:
- Please upload SAML metadata and a CSV of production CIDRs by EOD 2026-05-24.
- Ben will run a 30-minute dry-run with your IdP team on 2026-05-26; please propose a local time.
- Confirm cutover window (we proposed 2026-05-28 02:00–04:00 UTC).

If that timeline is tight, we can shift to the following week.

Thanks,

--
